hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude needs input or permission" with title "Claude Code: Notification"'
osascript -e 'display notification "A subagent is starting" with title "Claude Code: SubagentStart"'
osascript -e 'display notification "A task has completed" with title "Claude Code: TaskCompleted"'
osascript -e 'display notification "A subagent has stopped" with title "Claude Code: SubagentStop"'

input=$(cat); active=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false' 2>/dev/null); [ "$active" = "true" ] || osascript -e 'display notification "Claude has finished" with title "Claude Code: Stop"'
